title: Source criterion: zero principal reduction implies invertible scalar
statement: For an essentially small site J, a commutative coefficient ring R, a nonzerodivisor r of R, and K in the derived category of sheaves of R-modules, if derived reduction of K modulo the principal ideal (r) is zero then r times the identity of K is invertible.

source.place: Principal derived coefficient triangle, as proved in source Complete/Reduction.lean, isIso_smul_id_of_isZero_reductionModIdeal

proof.text: Tensor the distinguished two-term principal coefficient triangle by K. Its third vertex is the zero reduction, so its first arrow is invertible. The tensor unit comparison identifies this arrow with scalar multiplication by r. This is the existing complete source proof; no new Lean theorem is introduced.
